PM Modi Attends SRCC Centenary, Travels by Delhi Metro

Prime Minister Narendra Modi traveled by the Delhi Metro to attend the centenary celebrations of Shri Ram College of Commerce (SRCC) in New Delhi on Saturday. He was scheduled to address the event marking 100 years of the college. Earlier on Friday, the Prime Minister had met with teachers awarded at the national level, discussing education and nation-building. This visit to SRCC marks his return to the Delhi University college after 13 years, having previously spoken there in 2013 as Gujarat's Chief Minister.
